key_claims: A surprising two-year clinical trial found that fish oil supplements successfully delivered omega-3s to the brain but failed to improve memory or protect against Alzheimer's-related brain shrinkage. Researchers suspect that getting these nutrients through a healthy diet may offer benefits that supplements alone cannot provide.
limitations: The source did not expose enough detail for a fuller evidence extraction.
what_not_to_say: Do not claim causation, treatment, or guaranteed personal benefit.
